description: Implementation of PaymentService interface providing methods for payment processing, configuration management, and validation within an e-commerce application, specifically handling payment modules, transactions, and credit card validations.

classes.name: PaymentServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementing payment processing, configuration handling, and credit card validation for an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment integration modules for a specific merchant store, filtered by region.

methods.name: getAcceptedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Returns a list of accepted payment methods for a merchant based on configured payment modules.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByType
methods.description: Retrieves a payment method integration module by its type.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a payment method integration module by its code.

methods.name: getPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches the configuration for a specific payment module code.

methods.name: getPaymentModulesConfigured
methods.description: Loads all configured payment modules for a merchant store from encrypted configuration.

methods.name: savePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates and saves or updates configuration settings for a payment module.

methods.name: removePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a specific payment module configuration from a merchant store.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Coordinates the payment authorization or capture process, validating inputs and invoking the external payment module.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Retrieves an external payment module instance by its code.

methods.name: processCapturePayment
methods.description: Processes a capture transaction for an existing authorization, updating order and transaction status.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Handles refund processing for an order, including refund transaction creation and order total adjustment.

methods.name: validateCreditCard
methods.description: Validates credit card number, expiration date, and type for correctness and compliance.
